test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

Up a creek without a paddle

options.text: In a partially complete construction work
In a satisfied and calm atmosphere
In a troublesome and serious situation

solution:
The correct answer is **"In a troublesome and serious situation".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"Up a creek without a paddle" **comes from the image of being in a boat, up a creek, without having a paddle to navigate, a pretty daunting position to be in.
 
• It metaphorically signifies being in trouble with no clear or easy way out.
 
 
• **Example:** "After losing my job and having my car break down in the same week, I truly felt like I was up a creek without a paddle."
 
 
 
• In conclusion, the idiom** "Up a creek without a paddle" **describes a situation where someone finds themselves in a serious predicament or complex problem.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
